footnotes: Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 40.6% to $1.5B in 2025. Gross margin was 19.9%, versus 21.0% a year earlier, and operating income rose 6.7% to $73.1M, a 4.8% margin.
Net income fell 68.3% to $9.7M, or $0.17 per share. Operating cash flow was $9.0M and free cash flow −$5.2M, versus $55.2M; Aebi Schmidt returned $13.4M through dividends.
sources: Aebi Schmidt Holding AG Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
